property_summary: After any sequence of addToBalance calls, the total Ether balance of the contract should equal the sum of user balances; the buggy version increments user balance by msg.value+1, causing the contract's Ether balance to become less than sum of user balances over time.
change_summary: Replace `userBalance[msg.sender] += msg.value` with `userBalance[msg.sender] += msg.value + 1` so the balance increments by an extra wei.
